prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Phoenix to fix my air conditioning?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” HVAC company for every repair, but **Arizona Refrigeration Service** is a reasonable first call: it’s a long-established Valley company, and a recent local roundup says it takes emergency calls and offers same-day AC repair. Call **(602) 244-9900** to confirm availability and service to your address.

For a second quote, **Hobaica Services** is another Phoenix-based option (**(602) 995-0387**). Before booking either company, ask about the diagnostic fee, after-hours charges, and whether the technician will provide a written estimate before doing repairs. Also verify the contractor’s active Arizona ROC license at **roc.az.gov**.
